tieu_de: Business Analyst Travel Tech Web Mobile
mo_ta_cong_viec:
********************Prefer immediate employment / ƯU TIÊN ĐI LÀM NGAY********************
 
LEAP builds and operates an online travel booking platform serving multiple customer channels. We are looking for a Business Analyst who will own features from requirements to release: analyzing what needs to be built, then testing to make sure it is built right.
 
Requirements Analysis
Work with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders to gather, clarify, and prioritize requirements
Write user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, use cases, and business flows
Create process diagrams and basic wireframes/mockups
Act as the go-to person for business questions from the dev team throughout development
Manage requirement changes and keep documentation up to date
Analyze operational data and production issues to propose product improvements
Quality Support (as needed)
Verify that delivered features meet the agreed acceptance criteria before release
Support the team and clients during acceptance testing (UAT)
yeu_cau:
Must Have
Minimum 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst, or as a QC/Tester with hands-on requirements analysis
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, writing user stories with detailed acceptance criteria
Experience working on both the product design and technical sides of product development
Experience working with clients/stakeholders to manage the development of their product
Solid test case design and hands-on testing skills, including API testing (Postman or similar)
Clear, structured documentation skills and good English reading/writing
Available to start immediately or within a short notice period
Nice to Have
Strong experience on QC/Tester
Deep knowledge of mobile and web products
Product mindset: ability to think MVP and focus on the highest-priority features
Experience in travel, airline, e-commerce, or payment domains
Basic SQL for data verification
